summary: The page displays layout issues in the code viewer where text lines overlap and collide at small viewport widths.

issues.title: Code line text overlap
issues.description: Lines in the code block overlap vertically and collide with adjacent text due to improper line wrapping handling.
issues.evidence: Lines 1 and 2 text are superimposed directly on top of each other in the code pane.
issues.suggestion: Enable horizontal code scrolling or correct line-height and wrapping behavior.
